exposure: PMTCT strategies (combination neonatal prophylaxis, vaginal delivery with undetectable viral load, maternal and neonatal antiretroviral therapy)
cohort: 6503 mother-child pairs born in Italy between 1996 and 2016, from the Italian Register
finding: Despite optimization of PMTCT strategies, risk of MTCT in Italy persists, with vaginal delivery with detectable or missing viral load, prematurity, breastfeeding, lack of maternal or neonatal antiretroviral therapy, detectable maternal viral load, and age at first observation being associated with increased risk.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery with detectable or missing viral load or nonelective caesarean delivery was associated with increased risk of MTCT, while the proportion of vaginal deliveries in women with undetectable viral load increased over time with no infections occurring among them.
